0022600148.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (5-1, on a two-game winning streak and 2-0 on the road) visit the 3-3 Charlotte Hornets in the 76ers' seventh game of the season, with no games yet this season between the teams, though the 76ers won the 2025-26 series 2-1 and took their last meeting 118-114 in Charlotte on March 28, 2026. Charlotte, 8th in the East and on a two-game losing streak, is without Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, who are all listed as out. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, Jabari Walker and Tacko Fall, who are all out, while Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid and LeBron James are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions.
